question: FILL: one sentence comparing a treatment method with compute-matched baselines on a quality a judge can rate
hypothesis: FILL: what you expect, stated so that it can fail
matching: Per question, budget B is the mean total tokens of the treatment. Each baseline's n is the largest integer such that n single passes plus one selector call fit within B; the selector call is charged to the baseline.

judges.description: a model of a different family from the generator
a second judge: a human rater or a model of a third family

primary.test: one-sided paired sign-flip permutation across questions; Hedges g from per-question differences

falsification: FILL: the result that would make you say it did not work. A tie counts as failure. Judge agreement below min_alpha is inconclusive.
limits: FILL: at least one honest limit, for example who wrote the questions and how many there are
stopping_rule: One revision pass to prompts and questions after the controls pass, then lock. No edits after lock; a change means a new experiment directory.
